item.title: Family history of PCOS may alter metabolic care
item.description: A 30-year-old man with obesity and long-standing type 2 diabetes attends a routine follow-up. His blood sugar control remains poor despite treatment.

item.title: Chronic inflammation and immune aging may share mechanisms
item.description: For over twenty years, I have practiced emergency medicine. The job trains you to spot patterns quickly because sometimes the pattern is the point.

item.title: Blaming the doctor is cheaper than fixing the record system [PODCAST]
item.description: Subscribe to The Podcast by KevinMD. Watch on YouTube. Catch up on old episodes! A pediatrician gave a child vaccines the chart said he needed.

item.title: Activated donor immune cells may prevent severe complication after allogeneic stem cell transplantation
item.description: Researchers have successfully conducted the first clinical trial using activated regulatory T cells (ATregs, Actileucel) derived from white blood cells.
